title: Billing & Fees Policy
content:
Overdraft Fees: A $35 overdraft fee is charged only when an account balance goes below $0 after a transaction posts. Fees applied when the balance never went negative are billed in error and must be reversed upon verification of the ledger.

Monthly Maintenance Fee: Waived if the account maintains a minimum daily balance of $1,500, or if the customer has $500+ in monthly direct deposits.

Late Fees & Autopay: If autopay is active and the payment fails due to a system error (not insufficient funds), any late fee charged must be reversed automatically. Customers should be asked to confirm the autopay enrollment date to cross-check against the payment log.

Cancellation Fees: Subscription products may carry a cancellation fee only if canceled within the first 90 days of enrollment. After 90 days, cancellation is free of charge.

title: Foreign Transaction & FX Policy
content:
Exchange Rate Markup: International purchases are converted at the interbank rate plus a 2.5% foreign transaction fee. This markup is disclosed in the account terms and is standard across all consumer card products.

International Card Usage: All debit and credit cards work internationally by default unless a security block is active. Customers traveling abroad should set a travel notice to prevent fraud-related declines, but a travel notice is not required for the card to function internationally.

Travel Notices: Can be set for up to 90 days in advance and cover a specified date range and list of countries.

title: Interest & Credit Policy
content:
Interest & Grace Period: Interest is not charged on purchases if the full statement balance is paid by the due date shown on the most recent statement. If a payment posts after the due date -- even by one day -- interest accrues from the transaction date, not the due date. Payments must be verified against the exact statement cutoff time.

Credit Limit Increases: Customers are eligible for a credit limit increase if the account is at least 6 months old, has no late payments in the last 12 months, and current utilization is below 50%.

Premium Tier Upgrade: Requires an average balance of $10,000+ over the trailing 3 months or $2,000+ in monthly qualifying direct deposits. Premium tier waives most standard fees.

title: Fraud & Unauthorized Transaction Policy
content:
Unrecognized Charges: Any charge a customer does not recognize should be verified against merchant descriptor data before escalation. Charges over $100 that remain unrecognized after descriptor lookup are escalated to the Fraud Team within 1 business hour.

Unauthorized Transactions: If a customer confirms they did not make a transaction, the card must be frozen immediately, pending charges reversed provisionally, and a fraud case opened. Provisional credit is issued within 10 business days per standard dispute timelines.

Lost or Stolen Cards: Must be blocked immediately upon report, regardless of time of day, with a replacement card issued within 5-7 business days (expedited shipping available).

title: Phishing & Social Engineering Response Policy
content:
Identifying Phishing: The bank never asks customers to confirm a PIN, full card number, or online banking password via text, email, or unsolicited phone call. Any message requesting this information should be treated as fraudulent.

Customer Guidance: Advise customers not to click links or respond to suspicious messages, to report the message to the Fraud Team, and to monitor their account for the next 30 days. If any information was shared, the account should be flagged for enhanced monitoring and credentials reset immediately.

Vishing (Phone Scams): Same guidance applies. Confirm with the customer whether any sensitive data was disclosed before deciding whether to lock the account.

title: Identity Theft Response Policy
content:
Suspected Identity Theft: If a customer reports an account or credit line they did not open, initiate an identity theft case immediately. This includes placing a credit freeze with the bank's internal credit systems and advising the customer to file a report with the relevant national fraud reporting body.

Required Actions: Close or freeze the unauthorized account, document all affected products, and provide the customer with a case reference number and a checklist for reporting to external credit bureaus.

Timeline: Identity theft cases are treated as Critical priority and must be opened within 1 business hour of the report.

title: Account Services Policy
content:
Joint Account Requests: Both parties must be present (in person or via verified video call) and provide government-issued ID. Existing account history transfers to the joint account; a new agreement must be signed by both holders.

Name Changes: Require legal documentation (marriage certificate, court order, or updated government ID) before the name is updated on the account and reissued cards.

Account Closure: Accounts may be closed once all pending transactions clear and the balance is zero or withdrawn. Closure requests are processed within 1-2 business days.

title: Dispute & Refund Resolution Policy
content:
Duplicate Charges: Verified duplicate transactions are refunded within 24-48 hours once confirmed against transaction logs. Customers should be informed of this timeline immediately after the case is opened.

Refund Delays: Merchant refunds typically post within 5-10 business days. If a refund has not posted after 10 business days, escalate to the merchant acquirer for tracing.

Amount Mismatches: When a charged amount does not match a customer's receipt, request the receipt or order confirmation and open a formal dispute case with the merchant.
